title: Angular Frontend Development Mastery
description: Become capable of building, explaining, debugging, testing, and maintaining a real Angular frontend — covering standalone components, signals, dependency injection, RxJS, HttpClient, reactive forms, routing, and security — that communicates cleanly with a Spring Boot REST backend.

nodes.label: Angular Orientation
nodes.description: Understand Angular as an integrated application framework built on TypeScript — distinct from a UI library like React — and its core mental model of routes, components, services, and HttpClient connecting to a backend API, plus Node.js/npm's role in Angular tooling.
